text:
Marta: Heads-up — I need to leave Friday 6pm PT for a pre-holiday flight. Can someone cover the Friday night oncall (18:00-02:00 PT) and the early Saturday check? Not an incident but short notice. @ryan @devon

Ryan: I can take 18:00-22:00 PT Friday. Happy to triage anything that pops up. I'll grab pager.

Devon: I can pick up 22:00-02:00 and do the early Saturday 06:00 check-in. Swap sounds good.

Katie: Thanks — can you drop a quick handoff note (what to watch, recent deploys, any scheduled jobs)? Especially worried about the DB maintenance Saturday night.

Marta: Handoff below. Key items:
- Recent deploys: service-ingest v2.4.1 rolled at 2026-03-12 03:10 UTC (watch for increased requeues)
- Scheduled jobs: nightly-exports at 01:30 PT (Saturday) — expected to be low throughput
- DB maintenance: small vacuum + index refresh scheduled 23:30 PT (Saturday) — infra sent notice; low risk but may cause brief connection spikes
- Escalation: paging policy -> #eng-oncall -> if >15m unack, @sre-oncall
Quick commands:
```
# tail logs for ingest
kubectl -n prod logs -l app=service-ingest -f --tail=200
# check queues
curl -s https://status.internal/queues | jq '.ingest_backlog'
```
I'll set a calendar block on Friday 17:50 PT and add devon/ryan.

Oncall-bot: Reminder: DB maintenance (vacuum) scheduled 2026-03-14 23:30 PT. Expected downtime: none, monitor connections.

Devon: Got it, I'll watch the DB lines during my shift. If the vacuum causes retries, I'll backoff and open a support ticket.

Ryan: FYI I'm landing early Saturday morning; if anything persists beyond 02:15 PT I'll ping @devon. :thumbsup: 

Marta: Thanks everyone — appreciate the quick help. I'll DM deploy keys + runbooks to @devon and @ryan. Enjoy the holiday.
